args:
Fix try-on outfit consistency by passing flat-lay image as visual reference. Current issue: try-on generates random outfits instead of matching the actual recommended outfit shown in the flat-lay image.

  Changes needed:
  1. Update TryOnLooksRequest interface in apps/web/lib/services/fitting-model-service.ts to add 'flatLayImageUrl?: string' and 'flatLayImageBase64?: string' fields
  2. Update generateTryOnLooks() to accept and pass the flat-lay image as second reference image
  3. Update buildTryOnPrompt() to reference TWO images explicitly: IMAGE 1 for face/body (fitting model), IMAGE 2 for exact outfit (flat-lay)
  4. Create new method generateTryOnWithDualReference() in apps/web/lib/services/image-generation-service.ts that sends TWO images in the multimodal content array
  5. Update OutfitRecommendationCard.tsx handleTryOn() and handleRegenerate() to pass outfit.flatLayImageUrl or outfit.flatLayImageBase64 to generateTryOnLooks()

  The try-on prompt should explicitly say: 'Reference IMAGE 1 shows the person - match face and body EXACTLY. Reference IMAGE 2 shows the flat-lay of outfit items - the model must wear the EXACT same items with matching colors, patterns, styles, and design details. Do NOT modify, reinterpret, or change any aspect of the outfit.'

  The multimodal request must send both images in content array: [{ type: 'text', text: prompt }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: fittingModelBase64 }}, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: flatLayBase64 }}]
